title: Finite type flat module has a finitely presented stalk
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a finitely presented homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], let $N$ be a finite $B$-module [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime of $B$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. If the localization $N_{\mathfrak q}$ is flat as an $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $N_{\mathfrak q}$ is a finitely presented $B_{\mathfrak q}$-module [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation].
